economic_policy.taxation: Progressive carbon tax with revenue returned as citizen dividends; green tax shift from income to pollution and resource extraction; close corporate tax loopholes.
economic_policy.trade: Localise economies where possible; trade agreements must include binding climate and biodiversity standards; oppose trade rules that override domestic environmental law.
economic_policy.regulation: Precautionary principle for all new chemicals and technologies; mandatory environmental impact assessments; ban planned obsolescence; extended producer responsibility.

social_policy.healthcare: Universal single-payer healthcare with emphasis on preventive and holistic medicine; ban harmful pesticides linked to chronic illness; fund mental health parity.
social_policy.education: Free public education with environmental literacy as a core subject; outdoor and experiential learning; fund ecological research; democratic school governance.
social_policy.housing: Green building standards for all new construction; retrofit existing housing for energy efficiency; community land trusts; end homelessness through housing-first policy.
social_policy.civil_rights: Intersectional environmental justice; Indigenous sovereignty and land rights; LGBTQ+ protections; rights of nature enshrined in law.
social_policy.immigration: Recognise climate refugees; humane immigration policy; address root causes of displacement through fair trade and climate aid.

governance.decentralization: Bioregional governance; empower local and Indigenous communities in resource decisions; citizen assemblies on climate policy.
governance.transparency: Public access to all environmental monitoring data; ban corporate lobbying on environmental regulation; whistleblower protections.
governance.electoral_reform: Proportional representation; public campaign financing; lower voting age to 16; binding citizen referenda on major environmental issues.

environment.climate_action: Declare climate emergency; net-zero by 2035; ban new fossil fuel projects immediately; legally binding emissions budgets aligned with 1.5°C.
environment.energy: 100% renewable energy by 2035; ban nuclear new-build; community-owned solar and wind; phase out all fossil fuel subsidies immediately.
environment.conservation: Protect 30% of land and ocean by 2030; rewilding programmes; ban bottom trawling and deep-sea mining; pollinator protection plans.

security.defense: Shift from military to human security; cut defence spending and redirect to climate adaptation; establish a civilian climate corps.
security.law_enforcement: Restorative justice over punitive incarceration; community-based safety programmes; address environmental crime as a serious offence.
security.foreign_policy: Climate diplomacy as the centrepiece of foreign policy; lead international biodiversity agreements; cancel debts of climate-vulnerable nations.
